summary: Describes how mail clients and servers using IMAP, POP3 and ACAP can upgrade a plain connection to an encrypted one with TLS. It also defines a PLAIN login method for protocols that lack a simple password command. Later RFCs have updated it.

eli5.summary: Mail programs used to whisper their passwords out loud. This rule lets them first agree to talk through a locked tube, so nobody in the hallway can overhear the secret word.

questions: how to use tls with imap
